title: Partial source gauges and cube producers for conditional kappa = 9.26336e-5
body:
This extends my [PR #104](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/104) at `948ce1510df750f4c18b96bdaef436a86f8bf834`, with one new commit. The #10 → #18 → #24 → #32 → merged #36 → #104 proof lineage and attributed ordinary-leaf, two-stage and semantic/bulk interfaces are retained. PR #104 is the direct predecessor and is not yet merged.

Under the retained multiplication framework and those analytic/tape interfaces,

$$
T(n)=O\!\left(n(\log n)^{1-\kappa}\right),\qquad
\kappa=\frac{7237}{78125000}=9.26336\times10^{-5}.
$$

## Construction

The `(23,23)` bit network applies the stopped whole-projector compiler from #104 to the actual deferred physical word of **Zhihao Chen (jacklightChen)**'s #97, based on **Swapnil Jain**'s pinned witness. Every projector increment is one reversed child of its full rank. The strict coarse saving is `15513/125000000`; stopping at the inherited atom exponent `1/1000` gives ordinary bit saving `1240183559/10000000000000`.

The new `(24,24)` complex producer combines cyclic intervals and pair-first cube assembly. Its actual DAG has 146,284 additions, 120,097 compatible carrier links and 34,307 auxiliary roles. Frames are enlarged backwards through dependencies and carrier links, keeping a nondegenerate extension of each old frame inside the already selected successor frames.

The physical word selects 6,341 untouched roles for partial source gauges. Each gauge lies in the first source frame and all required target frames. Readouts execute in reverse selection order, giving actual nested target chains. A first transition of rank `r` becomes rank `r-dim(sigma)` and the exterior grows to `m-h+dim(sigma)`; all target-data transitions and the paid rank-one signed endpoint correction remain charged.

The strict complex saving is `92651/1000000000`. The bit and complex moment gaps exceed `1.1417e-10` and `4.1393e-11`. Exact rational centers retain divisor 21 and the completed-child `C1=1` contract. The larger maximum child widths, 528 and 574, require product row stock `p^40000`, with row coefficient 15,761. All 47 strict constraints and seven assembly margins hold; the final absorption gap exceeds `3.9406e-11`.

Baker–Harman–Pintz supplies the prime-interval theorem used by the adopted packing argument. Historical AI-assistance disclosures are preserved. The table records construction dependencies and contribution scope; independently published exponent savings are not added together.

## Proof and attribution

- `notes/partial-gauge-note.tex`: selected construction, chronological frame/gauge proof and assembly, supplied as LaTeX source.
- `scripts/partial_gauge_bit.py`: source-bound reconstruction of the pinned physical bit ranks and whole-projector child list.
- `scripts/partial_gauge_producer.py`: regeneration and independent finite checks of the new complex DAG, frames and readout schedule.
- `certificates/partial-gauge-network.json`: strict moments, stopped savings, semantic charge, product row stock and exact assembly.
- `references/partial-gauge/`: compact pinned witness, original proof sources, notices and licenses.

The result remains conditional on the retained analytic/tape interfaces, constructive setup and eventual thresholds. Finite checks do not formally verify the complete theorem. The inherited #10 patch and upstream community review records are preserved; this extension is presented in its standalone proof.

The new cube integration, compatible frame enlargement, partial source-gauge construction and composition are contributed by **icekylinx**, with substantial OpenAI GPT-6 Astra and Codex assistance. Source pins and contribution scope are recorded in `SOURCES.json` and `NOTICE`. Existing Apache-2.0 and imported CC0 terms, author credits and historical assistance disclosures are retained. Research alternatives, large generated graphs, duplicate handoffs and PDFs are excluded.

## Validation

- Checked the pinned PR #97 source hashes; reconstructed auxiliary, source-data and target-data ranks from the frozen physical paths; matched its ledger and rebuilt every whole-projector multiplicity.
- Rebuilt the selected h24 complex producer, matching, backward frame enlargement, physical word and partial gauges. All saved counts and histograms matched.
- Independently checked exact scalar supports and signed decoder, frame nondegeneracy and containment, carrier nesting, center closure, untouched selected roles, reverse readout chains and positive-rank transition counts. Zero-rank no-ops were compared through deterministic construction; their multiplicity does not enter the moment.
- Recomputed both rational moments, the stopped ordinary-bit saving, exact denominator-21 semantic charge, product row reserve, 47 strict constraints and seven assembly margins.
- Refreshed the joint-dual manifest's changed shared-file hashes and both dependent certificate digests. Recomputed joint arithmetic and checked that its mathematical fields and prior replay payload remain unchanged.
- Checked staged source hashes, deterministic certificate regeneration and the final diff. No PDF compilation was performed.

Unchanged previous-round and upstream full producer/complete-basis suites were not rerun. The reproduction command is `make partial-gauge-verify`; the incremental scope is documented in `docs/partial-gauge.md`.
